verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm custom CUDA kernels for NVIDIA, HIP for AMD GPUs, and MUSA for Moore Threads GPUs, directly matching the multi-vendor GPU acceleration story, with community reports corroborating real-world CUDA speedups. Missing for 10: hands-on community evidence specifically validating AMD/HIP or MUSA performance (community comments only cover NVIDIA/CUDA and Apple Metal).
